ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity dark pigment to high-intensity white scarring and mottling across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixels form contiguous bands along the distal trailing edges and terminal tips. Mid-to-lower lobe regions feature an array of small, circular high-contrast white clusters (rosettes) against a low-intensity dark background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate pixel-calculated angle of 82 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel-amplitudes. Notable deep, jagged valleys and sharp peaks are concentrated on the distal half of the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a concave sweep from the notch to the tips, with the tips exhibiting a sharp upward and inward curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread distribution of circular, ring-like white pixel clusters (2-15 pixel diameter) across both lobes, characteristic of barnacle attachment scars.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel linear white marks (rake marks) are visible on the right lobe, primarily oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular scarring and tissue degradation along the entire trailing boundary, particularly dense white pixelation at the terminal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, multi-peaked jagged protrusion on the trailing edge of the right lobe, roughly 60% of the distance from the notch to the tip.
